work.heading: Turning complex technology into measurable business outcomes
work.description: Focused on reusable platform capability, not buzzwords — every system is judged on stability, efficiency, and cost.

items.title: AI Platform & Multi-Agent Hub
items.summary: Combined RAG, SFT, and LangGraph state machines into a Planner + ReAct architecture; delivered Prompt Auto-Evolution and reusable Deep Research, PPT Agent, and multimodal capabilities with Agno and Dify.
items.result: Stable complex-task execution, faster customer support responses, and significantly lower manual tuning cost

items.title: Desktop Code Agent Workbench
items.summary: Built a desktop workbench with Tauri / Rust, a Node.js sidecar, and the Cline SDK; the server runtime uses Cline Core, an Agent Gateway, WebSocket, Redis, Celery, and Docker for task scheduling, sandbox orchestration, and real-time events.
items.result: Closed the loop across code search, execution, patching, correction, and multi-model access, with approval, reconnect, and automatic container reclamation.

items.title: End-to-End AI Video Production System
items.summary: Integrated script generation, task orchestration, model inference, elastic GPU scheduling, and automated editing into one observable production pipeline.
items.result: Overall compute cost down 30%+, throughput significantly improved

items.title: Billion-Scale AI Data Lake
items.summary: Built offline and real-time resume pools with Flink + Hudi, unified feature KV, behavior, and experiment data, optimized feature storage with Codis + Pika, and served non-hot data from MongoDB.
items.result: Reduced online load, cut offline-pool cost by 33%, and saved 80% of feature-storage memory

items.title: Model Engineering Platform & LLM Proxy
items.summary: Built a Kubeflow-inspired platform on Argo Workflow for experiments, training, storage, evaluation, and deployment; used LLM Proxy to monitor quality and cost across OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and DeepSeek.

items.title: Big Data & AI Task Platform
items.summary: Built a unified batch and streaming task platform on Amazon EMR, Kubernetes, and Argo Workflow, with Jupyter + Livy + Spark for data preparation, feature engineering, and exploration.
items.result: At least 30% faster feature work and 50%+ lower cost for inference and media tasks
